parameters.name: Credential
parameters.description: The name of the secret that contains the Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate and the certificate authority (CA) certificate.

parameters.name: ForceHttps
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enforce TLS encryption for connections. Valid values:

- `true`: Enforces TLS encryption for connections.

- `false`: Does not enforce TLS encryption for connections.

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: One or more hosts exposed by the gateway. Separate multiple hosts with commas (,).

parameters.name: IstioGatewayName
parameters.description: The name of the ASM gateway.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of gateway resources to query.

parameters.name: Number
parameters.description: The port number provided by the gateway.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.
